cases.question: How does pressure influence mineral deposition in Europe?

sources.full_text: Methods: Mineral deposition was measured in ore fluids sampled in Europe. Results: Lower pressure increased mineral deposition under controlled temperature. The laboratory result does not establish all field conditions.

sources.rationale: An authentic-style pressure experiment on rocks is not evidence for the deposition outcome.

sources.full_text: Methods: Crop yield was measured in paired organic farming and conventional farming fields in Europe. Results: Crop yield was lower in organic farming than conventional farming within the sampled fields. Management was not randomly assigned.

sources.rationale: One farming system alone cannot establish the requested between-system comparison.

sources.abstract: A comparison measures insect species richness across farming systems.

sources.rationale: Comparison vocabulary alone does not establish evidence about crop yield.
